assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D dress-up game asset: a charming illustrated helicopter beanie, isolated on genuine transparent background. This is a SINGLE asset sprite sheet, 4 columns x 2 rows, eight equally sized square cells with identical registration. No labels, borders, character, mannequin, text or shadows outside the object. Each cell shows the same warm mustard and soft sage fabric beanie with ribbed brim, tiny stitched detail, brass propeller mast and rounded cream/coral rotor blades. Soft storybook gouache, subtle watercolor grain, warm dark-brown clean outlines, gently shaded curved volumes; polished boutique mobile game quality. Straight front view, wearable on a round chibi animal head, open/transparent underneath the brim; not a standalone animal. Fill about 75 percent of each cell's width, upper-to-middle half of cell, leaving transparent padding all around. Rotate ONLY the little overhead two-blade propeller through 8 evenly spaced phase positions; beanie and mast remain pixel-aligned and visually identical in every cell. The eight frame poses must read as a continuous looping helicopter rotor. Avoid crude geometry, neon, black heavy outline, plastic 3D, photorealism, checkerboard painted background. Request actual alpha.
